name: io.github.privadovpn/x402-mcp
title: PrivadoVPN x402 Payer
description: Local MCP server that signs x402 USDC payments (Solana, EVM) to buy PrivadoVPN access

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base58-encoded Solana secret key used to sign and pay in SPL USDC. At least one of SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY or EVM_PRIVATE_KEY is required.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hex-encoded EVM private key used to sign EIP-3009 USDC authorizations. At least one of SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY or EVM_PRIVATE_KEY is required.

environmentVariables.name: PREFERRED_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Which network to prefer when a quote offers both. Accepts 'solana' or 'evm' ('eip155' is an accepted alias for 'evm'). Defaults to 'solana' if SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY is set, else 'evm'.

environmentVariables.name: X402_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the x402 payment backend used for catalog, quote, and fulfillment requests. Defaults to https://x402.privadovpn.com.

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC endpoint used to check balances and broadcast transactions. Defaults to https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: EVM RPC endpoint used to check balances and broadcast transactions. Required for EVM payments.
